deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] payments-service upgrade started: payments-chart v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 in namespace=prod (change-window 16:00-18:00 UTC)

deploy-bot: [FAIL] post-upgrade hook 'migrate-db' exit code 1. Hook logs:
```
ERROR: migration 2026_03_add_new_field failed: duplicate column 'status'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/migrate.py", line 92, in apply
    cur.execute(sql)
psycopg2.errors.DuplicateColumn: column "status" of relation "payments" already exists
```

sophie: saw the hook fail — change window is still open for ~22m. This is the payments schema migration failing in the post-upgrade hook. We need a decision: rollback to v3.2.0 or try a hotpatch to skip migration flag and continue canary?

rahul: quick context — v3.3.0 added an idempotent migration but apparently it isn't idempotent for this tenant due to earlier partial run. Skipping migration flag is risky but minimal downtime. Patch would be: `kubectl -n prod patch cm payments-config -p '{"data":{"skip_migration":"true"}}'` then `helm upgrade --reuse-values ...`

lin: if we patch values we should pause the canary and run full smoke + payments e2e. Also record rollback window. I'm leaning rollback: safer and faster to restore traffic.

jordan: rollback command if we go that route: `helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace prod` (revision 1 is the last healthy). We'll need to pin chart to v3.2.0 in the release manifest and create a follow-up fix branch for the migration.

olivia: also adding that service-level feature flag gating was intended for this — but ops missed toggling. If we rollback, change-log note: "Reverted payments-service to v3.2.0 after failed post-upgrade migration during 16:00-18:00 change window; follow-up patch scheduled."

sophie: options summary: 1) Rollback now (low risk, quick). 2) Patch CM to skip migration and continue (medium risk, requires manual e2e). 3) Let hook retry after small fix (slow, unknown). We need a vote. :ballot_box_with_check:

rahul: vote: patch and test, only if we can pause traffic and run canary verifications within 30m. Otherwise rollback.

lin: vote: rollback. We don't have small blast radius for DB weirdness.

jordan: vote: rollback.

olivia: vote: rollback. I'll draft the release note entry and postmortem stub.

sophie: consensus = rollback. Taking action now.

sophie: Executing: `helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace prod`

deploy-bot: [ACTION] helm rollback triggered by sophie for payments-service -> target revision=1

deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] rollback complete, pods stabilized (3/3 ready) in prod. Post-rollback smoke passed.

olivia: added release-note: "rollback: payments-service -> v3.2.0 due to failing post-upgrade hook (DB migration). Follow-up: fix migration idempotency and add tenant-safe guard. Owner: @rahul. ETA: 1 business day."

jordan: file a PR to pin chart version in chart-locks and add helm preflight check for migration idempotency.

rahul: will own the migration fix. I'll triage the failing SQL and add `IF NOT EXISTS` guard. Also will add a dry-run preflight hook to catch this in future.

lin: schedule a 15m post-rollback runbook review in 30m — want to capture decision timeline and update runbooks to include skip flag and preflight smoke.

sophie: thanks everyone. Closing this thread once runbook note is committed. :thumbsup:
